description: This file defines internal classes related to activity propagation and call filtering within the Orleans runtime. It includes abstractions for propagating distributed tracing context for outgoing and incoming grain calls, facilitating activity correlation across distributed components.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationGrainCallFilter
classes.description: An abstract base class providing functionality to propagate activity context details across grain call boundaries in Orleans, including setting activity tags and handling exceptions.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationOutgoingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: Implements outgoing call filtering by creating activities, injecting context, and processing calls to propagate distributed tracing information.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationIncomingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: Handles incoming grain call filtering by extracting tracing context from incoming requests and creating corresponding activities for distributed trace correlation.

methods.name: GetActivitySource
methods.description: Returns the appropriate ActivitySource based on whether the call is within Orleans namespace or external.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Handles setting activity tags and tags upon exceptions, and manages activity lifecycle during grain call processing.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Methods for the outgoing and incoming filters that initiate or extract activity context and proceed with the call invocation.
